item.title: How to configure a pfsense router with split VLANs
item.description: This example installation will use the ODroid H3 as the core pfsense router for a home installation. ODroid H3+ with 6 NICs This configuration includes an addon card for a total of six 2.5Gbps Ethernet network controllers (NICs). ODroid H3+ parts list Network design The six NICs on the odroid will be used like this: port 1: WAN - wide area network, ie. the internet. Connect this to your ISP. port 2: MGMT - management interface (This will be initially called LAN during setup) port 3: TRUNK -___ TRUNK aggregates 5Gb bandwidth from ports 3+4 port 4: TRUNK -/ port 5: OPT3 - available for future expansion port 6: OPT4 - available for future expansion All of the home networks are defined as VLANs accessible from the TRUNK aggregate link:
